name: Продажи: входящий лид
description: Human-in-the-loop процесс продаж для сигналов из Telegram-чата лидов. Специалист разбора лидов структурирует входящий сигнал, владелец продаж принимает решение, готовит содержательное предложение, запрашивает оценку и собирает КП/follow-up. Процесс заменяет захардкоженные напоминания явным состоянием workflow.

documents.name: Инструкция по разбору входящего лида
documents.content: Classify the Telegram signal from the lead chat. Return structured output with lead_relevant:boolean, lead_type:string, summary:string, customer_need:string, company:string|null, contact:string|null, source_chat:string, next_action:string. Do not prepare a proposal at this step; only triage and extract facts.

documents.name: Инструкция по human review лида
documents.content: Review the lead triage output and decide whether the signal should continue through the sales funnel. Return decision:string, lead_relevant:boolean, missing_context:string[], next_action:string, owner_notes:string. If context is insufficient, request clarification instead of inventing facts.

documents.name: Инструкция по уведомлению владельца продаж
documents.content: Notify the sales owner that a new Telegram lead reached human review. Include source chat, short summary, why it may be sales-relevant, and what decision is needed next. Do not qualify the lead silently; produce an explicit owner-facing notification and next_review_action.

documents.name: Инструкция по содержательному предложению
documents.content: Prepare the meaningful proposal before pricing: problem framing, value hypothesis, target users, scope outline, discovery questions, assumptions, risks, and suggested next client-facing message. Return proposal_outline and open_questions.

documents.name: Инструкция по запросу оценки
documents.content: Translate the content proposal into an estimate request for PM/tech review. Include scope, deliverables, integrations, non-functional risks, unknowns, and estimation questions. Return estimate_scope, risks, and questions_for_team.

documents.name: Инструкция по КП и follow-up
documents.content: Assemble the commercial proposal or next follow-up from the approved content and estimate inputs. Return client_summary, pricing_input, open_questions, follow_up, and next_action.

documents.name: Инструкция по follow-up напоминанию
documents.content: A follow-up reminder became due. Review the case context and prepare the next manual follow-up action. Return follow_up_status, recommended_message, and next_action.

elements.label: Проверить лид и выбрать следующий шаг
Уведомить владельца продаж о новом лиде
